notes.title: Jini's Potion Shop #Hotfix Beta 0.1.4-553
notes.content:
Hotfix #Beta 0.1.4-553
Date: 2025.01.05

Farewell to Sluggish Crafting Speeds!

Hello, Magicians. Happy New Year! May your cauldrons bubble with joy, and your spells shine brilliantly!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098966/d23e40c693f0784bc39e42ad5f9e73328f9ae063.png


Gameplay Improvements

 Crafting Level Benefits Added: If Jini’s snail-paced crafting has been driving you crazy, rejoice! As you level up, your crafting speed and sales revenue both get a boost.
 Skill and Buff Duration Display: Guess no more! The remaining time for buffs now appears on icons in the bottom-left corner.
 Tamer Monsters: Moths, flower seeds, and grass seeds will no longer attack Jini first—they’ve calmed down nicely.
 Shorter Monster Detection in the Deep Forest: Monsters won’t spot Jini from so far away anymore.
 Reduced XP Requirements for Crafting: You’ll need less XP for crafting in the shop, making it easier to level up.
 Treasure Chests Stop Glowing: Once all items are removed, the chests no longer emit light—no more wasted clicks.
 Dungeon Entry Confirmation: A confirmation prompt now appears to prevent unintentional dungeon hopping.
 Rokta Hyu’s Breathing Exercises at the Counter: Rokta Hyu now takes calming breaths at the counter, adding a fun little detail to your shop.
 Mysterious Peddler Visit Frequency: Tired of waiting for the peddler to show up? They’ll now appear during “Low Moon” and “Super Sun”!
 Monster Item Drop Timing: Items drop after the monster’s death animation completes—no more awkward timing.
 New Color for ‘NO’ Button: The ‘NO’ button in confirmation windows stands out more, reducing misclicks.
 Forest Layout Changes: To spare you sudden tough battles (or the tragedy of no lemons!), TeamLamp has planted lemon trees and removed wasps from safe paths in the village forest.


Bug Fixes

 [spoiler]Mysterious Magician Encounter Bug Fixed[/spoiler]: Resolved an issue where the [spoiler]Mysterious Magician[/spoiler] kept talking to Jini even after completing certain quests.


We’re always grateful for your thoughtful feedback and bug reports!
TeamLamp is currently preparing major updates and new stages that could fundamentally reshape the game—just as you Magicians have suggested. Look forward to more magical, innovative changes in our next big update. Thank you for your continued support.

With the blue baby snake by our side,
Sincerely, TeamLamp

notes.title: Jini's Potion Shop #Hotfix Beta 0.1.3-536
notes.content:
Hotfix #Beta 0.1.3-536
Version: Beta 0.1.3-536
Date: 2024.12.29

Improvements to the Dreadful Mixer Usage and the Chaotic Magical World

Hello, Magicians,

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098966/19112078c065a1b5580e2de01d44f1c40d94e567.png
TeamLamp has once again brought urgent patch details to support your adventures. To make your forest exploration even more thrilling, we have prepared the following improvements:

New Features:
[olist]
 Jini's Diary Mixer Tab: Confused about how to use the mixer? A new mixer tab has been added to Jini's Diary, making it easy to check the necessary synthesis item list and take on the challenge. A cute ghost-jelly is waiting for you (to be eaten)!
 Increased Customer Request Frequency: Having trouble dealing with the rare items piled up in your storage? The frequency of requests from magicians visiting Jini's Potion Shop has increased. Use the revamped NPC UI to identify their preferred items and make sales.
 Additional Descriptions for Props: Special stories have been added to the frames and small props in Jini's Potion Shop.
[/olist]

Gameplay Improvements:
[olist]
 Weakening of Deep Forest Monsters: For those of you venturing deep into the forest, the previously overwhelmingly powerful fireballs and ghosts have been weakened.
 Weakening of the Pumpkin King: The formidable Pumpkin King that had plunged you into despair has lost its power. Now, you can defeat this boss and achieve great accomplishments!
 [spoiler]Poltergeist[/spoiler] Attack Pattern Added: [spoiler]The Poltergeist[/spoiler] has launched a new terrifying spirit projectile. Dodge quickly and strike back.
[/olist]

Additional Updates:
[olist]
 Item Updates: The names and images of some items have been changed to better fit the potion-making world view, and sales prices have been added for all items except potions. Present these newly revamped items to your customers for sale!
 Two New Synthesis Items Added: Jini has welcomed two new synthesis items. Use these items to discover more diverse potion formulations and expand your potion-making techniques.
[/olist]

We hope this patch will make Jini's journey shine even brighter. Continue to enjoy your rather threatening adventures.

Preparing for the bombardment of spirits,
Sincerely, TeamLamp

notes.title: Jini's Potion Shop #Hotfix Beta 0.1.2-519
notes.content:
Hotfix #Beta 0.1.2-519
Version: Beta 0.1.2-519

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098966/1fea6279fdb9431918c154b3462f86557874c5c3.png

Hello, Magicians of the Magical World,
Thank you so much for your courageous reports and invaluable feedback regarding the strange incidents happening in the magical realm. Your contributions have been a tremendous help in continuously improving our world of magic.

Date
2024.12.25

Content Improvements:

 Potion Price Adjustments Adjusted the selling prices of certain potions, including the Paralysis Potion, Warp Potion, and Freeze Potion.
 Added Greetings Fixed an issue where some characters did not give thanks, ensuring everyone greets politely now.
 Kiira’s Puzzle-Shaped Pendant Buff Adjustment Modified the buff activation rate for Kiira’s Puzzle-Shaped Pendant.
 Anniversary Events Applied Special discount events will be held on certain days at Mago’s General Store and Siett’s Alchemy Shop.
 Inventory UI Update Changed the bag inventory UI to a vertical layout for easier viewing.
 Increased Font Size in Settings Enlarged the UI font for improved readability.
 Repositioned Elements in the Dungeon Village Forest Rearranged some elements (trees, traps) in the Dungeon Village Forest to make exploration more enjoyable.

Regarding Recipe Inspirations:

We have added clearer explanations for each potion recipe inspiration, making it easier for magicians to understand and use these recipes.

Bug Fixes:

 Fixed an Issue with Undeletable Items Resolved a problem where items that should be deleted during crafting, synthesis, or dismantling processes were not being removed.
 Fixed Errors in Synthesis and Crafting Results Addressed an issue where items disappeared or incorrect items were granted after crafting or synthesis.


As members of this magical world, your passion and magic continue to inspire everyone at TeamLamp. We hope this hotfix enriches the realm of magic even further. Keep on adventuring!

May the small blessings of everyday life be with you, as always.
TeamLamp

notes.title: Community Update #1:
notes.content:
Community Update #1:  Beta Test Begins!
Version: Beta 0.1.0-504

Hello, fellow Magicians!
How was your year 2024? At TeamLamp, we spent it working tirelessly on development, motivated by your warm support.
Now, the long-awaited ‘Jini's Potion Shop’ Beta Test is finally here!

Starting today, supporters who received a Steam beta key can enjoy an early look at the game. This beta test is a valuable opportunity to experience core gameplay and key systems before the official release. As you play, if you find anything inconvenient or have ideas for improvement, feel free to share your thoughts through the in-game feedback feature. Your feedback will make the game even more polished.

What’s in the Beta Test?

 2 new maps unlocked
 Potion recipes added
 Complete overhaul of potion recipes
 Convenience and UI responsiveness improvements


Moving Toward the Full Release

 Even after this beta, TeamLamp is charging ahead toward the full release, adding 3 more stages, new potions, and other content. We’ll use your valuable feedback to build a richer, more fun magical world. (Magicians, we’d love your help in this process!)


‘Jini's Potion Shop’ was born from our wish to create a small, cozy game that warms the heart.
Even during the cold winter, we genuinely hope a bit of peace finds its way into your daily life. 🌟
Spring is just around the corner.

Carrying the brightest moth lamp,
TeamLamp

notes.title: As We Conclude the Next Fest
notes.content:
Hello, brave magician!

We sincerely welcome you to Jini's Potion Shop, once an unknown place that had never been visited until the Steam Next Fest.

We have carefully read every bit of your valuable attention and thoughtful feedback.

The following improvements will be made in the next demo update:

  1. Issue where ingredients are being placed in the recipe load tab
  2. Problem where the position isn't reset when moving to the next quest after reading a long entry in the quest tab
  3. Text being too small to read properly



For the official release, we will address all the major issues based on your feedback. The key features that received the most feedback and require an overall remake are as follows:

 1. Overall improvements and enhanced convenience in the quest tab
 2. Increasing the fun of potion-making and learning through crafting failures
 3. The issue where diary recipes do not match crafting recipes


We apologize for any inconvenience caused during gameplay. To provide a better potion-making experience, Teamlamp is committed to figuring out how we can ensure that you, our magicians, can enjoy learning through delightful failures, and we will apply those solutions. 🧪

It was truly a meaningful time, and we are sincerely grateful for you pointing out areas we hadn’t noticed.
Thank you so much for visiting this tiny shop and embarking on adventures with Jini. We look forward to your continued, quiet interest.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45098966/eb778ba47c6e6b61506e508e3be4c8f9f115b647.png

Lastly, we're excited to unveil the concept art for a new map coming with the official release. We're working on more stages and potions, so stay tuned!  🌿
